name: Section on road 1665 Hallingavägen at Legeved
description: A random 1.3 km of county road 1665: OSM tags it "M 1665", signed and shown as 1665, and names it Hallingavägen. OSM: the hamlet Legeved is 0.1 km from its north end and 1.4 km from its south end (just within reach), nothing bigger near.
